name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: One setting that is on or off and takes effect at once: sound, haptics, rival alerts. Specimen 4b draws it beside field's checkbox and radio and 4d puts the same control at the end of a settings row, so it is the third pressed control of that family and wears the same raised elevation and the same press gesture. It is a switch and not a checkbox: a checkbox states an intention a submit will act on later, a switch is the act, so the role is `switch` and the state is `aria-checked`. Locked keeps its shape, shows a padlock and stays in the tab order; disabled goes flat and leaves it, and disabled wins when both are set. Performs nothing: it does not mute anything, remember a preference or write to storage, so a save that fails on the server never leaves the pill saying the setting took. Use `field` with `control="checkbox"` when the answer is part of a form the player submits.
docs: Pass `checked` and `onChange`; the host owns the value and hands it back, so the pill never keeps one of its own. `label` is always the accessible name. Pass `labelHidden` where the surface around it already says the words, as specimen 4d's settings row does. `locked` for a setting that is available later, `disabled` for one that is not coming back.
